decisions.reason: The weir-dimensioning web tool costs little to maintain and steers planners toward the firm's core weir hardware, so it shows no shortfall against aspirations that would call for search.

The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the established flood-control offer and was launched only recently, and the expanding firm has enough slack to carry it while municipal procurement results build up.

Energy management for water facilities fits the firm's strategic direction of digital networking and energy recovery, so management will tolerate uncertain early results instead of judging it against short-term aspirations.
The overflow flap gate line has several models and its own web page, which signals solid performance and commitment in the firm's core hardware business.
